user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's birthday. Can you suggest some popular albums from their favorite artist, along with the details of those albums? Also, find some interesting books on party planning and decoration ideas to make the event more special.

TaskList.description: Identify the favorite artist of the user's best friend.
Retrieve a list of popular albums from the identified artist and their details.
TaskList.dependency: This step requires the result from Subtask 1.

TaskList.description: Search for interesting books about party planning.
Find decoration ideas for surprise parties.
